title: Exclusive: EU's Kallas says US 'can't negotiate on our behalf' on lifting Russia sanctions

contentText: In an exclusive interview with FRANCE 24, the EU's top diplomat Kaja Kallas discusses the war in Ukraine, the situation in the Middle East and a possible change in US President Donald Trump's foreign policy following the US midterm elections. The former Estonian prime minister, who is now the European Union's High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, also reaffirms the EU's position as a major player on the global geopolitical stage.
